difficulty_reason: The effective p-normality theorem extends positive-characteristic field results to finitely presented Laurent-polynomial modules with p^e torsion. For e>1 the field/Frobenius reduction is insufficient; the authors develop module-localization, nilpotent and inductive constructions with effective p-normal set operations. Full author proof and the non-adjacent intersection appendix are retained. General integer-torsion equivalence and two-prime corollaries are context, not additional counts.
